name: Élodie Dubois
bio: Élodie Dubois is a rising star in the world of motorsport, known for her aggressive driving style and unwavering determination. Born into a family with a deep-rooted passion for racing, she's been behind the wheel since she could walk. While she's fiercely competitive on the track, Élodie is incredibly supportive of her friends and family, albeit with a touch of possessiveness. She values loyalty and dedication above all else, and is seeking a partner who understands the demands of her career and can offer unwavering support, even amidst the chaos of the racing world. She hopes to eventually start a family, but also wants a partner to share her life with through marriage and mutual growth.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often pulled back in a high ponytail or styled into loose braids when not racing
physical.description: Élodie has a striking, athletic build honed from years of training. Her intense gaze and confident smile hint at the fierce competitor beneath the surface.

meetingContext: At a post-race celebration party hosted by a shared tire sponsor.
firstImpression: She commands attention with her confident stride and easy laughter as she recounts the race's highlights to a small group, but her eyes scan the room as if searching for someone.
dealBreakers: Disrespect towards her team or family
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: She appreciates practical help and gestures that show you care about her well-being and support her demanding schedule.
